soft_regions.name: tread_patch

selection.selector: P: subset of Wminus with z < -0.463 and radial distance sqrt((y+0.170)^2+(z+0.412)^2) > 0.070; a bottom outer tread patch, including its sidewall surface. Exclude these source faces from wheel_minus rigid mesh.
selection.reason: Small native tread patch chosen for one inexpensive nonrigid attempt; boundary pinned to rotating wheel frame.

young_modulus.reason: Soft tire prior for a coarse bounded test; no measured modulus.

load_depth.reason: Bounded radial indenter travel, retract after hold.

grid_spacing.reason: Coarse covering tetrahedral block; refine only if binding cannot cover native vertices.

soft_regions.reason: Tread texture and annular geometry support a possible elastic material, without observed compression. Use one coarse 3D tetrahedral flex volume covering P exactly enough for nonnegative barycentric rest reconstruction. Pin inner and perimeter nodes to wheel_minus; leave central outer patch free. Bind every patch render vertex, without duplicate rigid faces. Real contact probe load/unload while wheel is held, then show patch following an unrestricted full wheel turn. Stiffness is an editable hypothesis and failed deformation remains reported.

native_scale.reason: Uniform scale prior; preserve native proportions.

native_offset.reason: Chosen grounding transform, not observed hardware.

interactions.name: lid_cycle
interactions.action: Short host trajectory: 0 to pi/4 to pi/2 and back; hold shell rest pose with a temporary external test fixture/wrench, without changing free joint graph.
interactions.expected: Visible lid, raised panel and grips open together; fixed ribs remain shell; inspect hinge continuity at 0,45,90 degrees. Full 90-degree initial range retained.

interactions.name: spin_cycle
interactions.action: Exercise wheels separately and together using unwrapped position targets 0,pi,2*pi,2.5*pi with finite effort and no actuator angle bounds; sample 0,pi/2,pi,3*pi/2 for attachment.
interactions.expected: Actual wheel surfaces rotate beyond one full turn without stops. Flex patch remains attached to negative-X hub with owner offsets handled by supported preview mapping.

interactions.name: patch_press_release
interactions.action: Hold wheel and shell; contact a small mocap probe radially into the bottom patch up to 0.006 m, hold, retract, recover in the same host physics attempt.
interactions.expected: Measure nonrigid visible displacement after subtracting owner rigid motion, contact and recovery; record failure honestly if no adequate deformation or binding.

interactions.name: bounded_transport
interactions.action: Apply a short bounded external force and torque at upper shell to attempt <=0.15 m translation and approximately 15-degree tipping; release. Do not keyframe physics.
interactions.expected: Whole assembly follows free root; wheel-ground behavior is measured and failure does not remove useful lid or spin preview.

review_requirements: Account for all 198613 source faces exactly once across shell, lid, both rigid wheels and tread_patch, applying P first and subtracting it from the entire rigid remainder. Verify UV/PBR and rest geometry preservation. Inspect the resulting visible wheel and lid boundaries; record any fixed wheel fragments or incorrectly moving rim/rib faces. Any added hinge members must have the approved owner, placement and area ledger.

Inspect actual bound surfaces at lid_open=0,pi/4,pi/2 and wheel representative poses 0,pi/2,pi,3*pi/2. Confirm grips and raised panel follow lid, fixed ribs follow shell, hinge attachment stays visibly connected, both wheels remain centered on their axle attachments, and the active tread patch stays joined to its wheel. Record gaps and owner-offset errors. Use only the approved bounded hinge connectors if needed; do not reconstruct a detailed interior or add angular stops.

Within the single short host MuJoCo attempt, test visible lid opening toward pi/2 and return, each wheel separately and together with unwrapped position exceeding 2*pi, and the bounded free-root transport action. Compile both spin joints limited=false with no range and no angle-limited position actuator. Record actual joint/root states and visible mesh displacement relative to each parent, endpoint errors, stability and failures; distinguish tested success from parameter-preview motion. Preserve the free-root graph when temporary test support is used.

Implement actual nondegenerate tetrahedral flex and nonnegative normalized skin weights reconstructing every tread_patch render vertex within 0.001 of the metric native diagonal. Keep central outer nodes unpinned and boundary/inner support attached to wheel_minus. In the same host attempt, load with the radial probe up to the declared 0.006 m travel, retract, and measure contact, visible nonrigid displacement after removing owner motion, and recovery. Use a load setup with clearance so ground contact or a rigid wheel proxy does not shield the patch. Verify flex/skin following during wheel rotation; report failed response or binding honestly.

Use the frozen contact helper for sampled neutral and exercised poses: apply the 1 percent diagonal baseline, and use the extension only with its required measured locality evidence. Record broad/deep overlaps and stability failures without inventing exemptions. Never range-limit a continuous joint. Deliver the complete native GLB, MJCF, action plan and manifest with all core controls and the actual soft attempt, clearly separating planned actions, measured successes, preview-only actions and missing/failed actions. No extra full simulation is authorized.

interaction_coverage.label: Lift and close lid
interaction_coverage.reason: Seam and rear attachment support one lid assembly; +X rotation raises the positive-Y front edge.

interaction_coverage.label: Rotate both wheels continuously
interaction_coverage.reason: Two native circular wheel planes support separate transverse axle rotations; coupling is unobserved.

interaction_coverage.label: Tip and translate whole container
interaction_coverage.reason: Whole-object handling is represented by a free root, not an invented internal tipping hinge. External bounded wrench acts on shell in the short demo.

interaction_coverage.label: Compress and recover one tread patch
interaction_coverage.reason: One active visible flex attempt; additional tread follows its rigid wheel owner.

deferred_compliance.name: remaining_tread_minus
deferred_compliance.reason: All negative-X tread outside P stays on wheel_minus while the small active patch supplies a real deformation attempt.

deferred_compliance.name: tread_plus
deferred_compliance.reason: Secondary tire follows rotating owner with unchanged geometry; no deformation claimed.

approximation_gaps.reason: Closed neural surface does not establish a hollow interior or correct lid underside; opening may expose incomplete internal geometry. Preserve it and label this gap; cavity reconstruction is outside this preview.

Coarse shell wall/base boxes, lid slab and wheel cylinders approximate contact; detailed ribs and hidden internal clearance are unverified. Use existing tolerant helper without claiming strict collision-free validation.
Only one local tread patch deforms; remaining annulus and opposite tire retain native geometry following their wheel owner, without deformation claims.
